title: Kagu (R) - Developer Guide
text: Backend-agnostic interface (mechanism owns full lifecycle): - $fit(node, parents, data, ...) → opaque fit object - $predict_mean(node, parents, parent_values, fit) → [1, n_draws] matrix - $log_marglik(node, parents, data) → scalar (discovery) - $posterior_shape(fit) → c(n_chains=1, n_draws) - $node_terms(node, parents, data, fit) → summary rows GPMechanism (default ): node exact Gaussian process squared-exponential ARD kernel (one lengthscale per parent → non-linearity interactions free), hyperparameters type-II ML. Root nodes (parents) use marginal Normal. Key internals: - .rbf() - squared-exponential ARD kernel standardised inputs. - .gp_core() - type-II ML fit (optim/L-BFGS-B), Cholesky K + σ², exact log marginal likelihood (used discovery - well calibrated). - .gp_add_sampler() / .gp_eval() - pathwise (decoupled) sampling: random-Fourier-feature prior + exact data update (Matheron’s rule), giving S coherent function samples evaluable point. matched = TRUE returns diagonal f^(s)(Xnew[s, ]) per-draw propagation. exact, basis approximation: previously used BayesGPfit eigen-basis, benchmarking showed truncated basis approximations -confident structure discovery (manufacture spurious direction preference linear-Gaussian edges proper GP correctly can’t identify). exact GP O(n^3) fine small-data setting kagu targets.

title: Causal structures: confounder, mediator, collider, M-bias
text: confounder z causes x y. Naive OLS y ~ x without adjusting z biased; Kagu uses full structural model. True effect x y: +1.5.  Notice naive OLS estimate sits well 1.5 - confounding path x ← z → y leaks association slope. adjusted OLS correct happened condition z. Kagu’s table recovers ≈ 1.5 90% HDI comfortably around truth, structural model represents z common cause -operator severs incoming edge x.
code: z → x → y z → y z <- rnorm(N) x <- 1.0 * z + rnorm(N, sd = 0.5) y <- 1.5 * x + 1.0 * z + rnorm(N, sd = 0.5) df_confounder <- data.frame(z = z, x = x, y = y) cat("OLS (naive):   ", coef(lm(y ~ x, df_confounder))[["x"]], "\n") #> OLS (naive):    2.297737 cat("OLS (adjusted):", coef(lm(y ~ x + z, df_confounder))[["x"]], "\n") #> OLS (adjusted): 1.500995 model_confounder <- KaguModel$new(dag = list(z = c(), x = c("z"), y = c("x", "z"))) model_confounder$fit(df_confounder) model_confounder$plot_dag(node_pos = list(   z = c(0, 0), x = c(1, -1), y = c(1, 1) )) model_confounder$effects("x", "y", values = c(0, 1))$summary() #> # A tibble: 1 × 8 #>   source target  from    to  mean     sd hdi_lower hdi_upper #>   <chr>  <chr>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl> #> 1 x      y          0     1  1.51 0.0463      1.43      1.58

text: m collider non-causal path. true effect x y +1.0. Conditioning m opens spurious path via b, biasing naive adjusted OLS estimate. text: Models node's conditional mean exact Gaussian process parents, squared-exponential (ARD) kernel - one lengthscale per parent, captures non-linearity interactions automatically. Structure discovery uses exact GP log marginal likelihood, - contrast fast basis/eigenfunction approximations - well calibrated: genuinely unidentifiable (e.g. linear-Gaussian) edge manufacture spurious confidence direction. Posterior function samples effect propagation drawn pathwise / decoupled sampling (random-feature prior plus exact data update), draw coherent function evaluable point - giving correctly correlated uncertainty -calculus contrasts.
